access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; also can use GPAW. Install via conda/pip.

Standard hcp structure (space group P6_3/mmc) with lattice constants a=2.665 Å, c=4.947 Å. Widely available in crystallographic databases (ICSD, COD). The agent can generate the structure from these parameters.

Standard body-centered tetragonal (I4_1/amd) with lattice constants a=5.832 Å, c=3.181 Å. Widely available in crystallographic databases (ICSD, COD). The agent can generate the structure from these parameters.
